title: Which date/rate-kind/currency projections and same-day two-leg comparison are supported?
resolution:
Open: nonblocking to architecture, mandatory before the affected integration. 14 AW target currencies, one supported pair/day, one missing business day and DEM/FRF/VEB counterexamples; SIX rights separate. Expected payoff: Complete S2 explicit-price comparisons without guessed currency.

Phase3 root-acceptance binding: remains OPEN and blocks phases4/5/6 completion for the affected selected scenario. It does not block work on unrelated accepted paths. Closure requires dedicated semantic decisions and source/legal/coverage evidence for the scoped integration, or an explicit root-reviewed narrower portfolio with retained rejected/deferred paths. A source observation alone cannot close this question.

Root scope decision 2026-10-07 (evidence/s2-initial-scope-decision.json): initial S2 is limited to already accepted non-FX unit/language and same-source product-key paths, plus explicit Chinook catalogue-price context. Historical AdventureWorks→ECB comparison is deferred retained research; daily ECB stays separate conditional discovery. No complete comparable international prices, quantity/FX conversion, new mapping, implementation, source-rights or activation acceptance. The original proposal and dependencies above remain research history. p3-followup-2 stays open/blocking: CLDR display/alt, currency intervals/multiplicity, digits/precision and missing-business-day evidence remain open. Literal 14 AW targets and DEM/FRF/VEB counterexamples remain; the recorded Saturday gap is not eligible-business-day evidence.
